messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — spotted a couple of inconsistencies between the in-product docs panel copy and the main console UI on Routes > Details. Small stuff but confusing for new users :eyes:
Ravi Patel: where are the mismatches? screenshot?
Maya Chen: attaching gist in a sec but gist summary: the docs panel uses 'Model variant' and 'Inference tier'; the console UI shows 'Serving variant' and 'Capacity tier'. Users read both and get mixed signals.
Clara Gomez: ugh that explains the support ticket about 'which variant to pin' — they tried to pin a Capacity Tier instead of a Variant.
Leo Park: can we pick a single canonical term? prefer 'Model variant' (keeps it model-centric) + 'Instance tier' for infra.
Maya Chen: +1 to canonicalizing. Also accessibility nit: the docs panel deep-link anchor isn't keyboard-focusable — tab stops skip the "Open docs" link. Screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/route-docs-focus.png
Ravi Patel: noted. Quick deep link format we use elsewhere is /console/docs?doc=routes&routeId=<id>#variant — we should make the docs panel produce the same path so copy/paste works.
Maya Chen: example deep link we could standardize on (for copy into emails):
```
https://console.redwood.ai/docs/routes?routeId=abc123&section=variant
```
This should open the docs flyout focused on the Variant subheading.
Clara Gomez: also found a microcopy mismatch inside the docs fragment — we say "pin variant to route" but the pin CTA in the UI reads "lock to variant". users interpret differently.
Leo Park: ok action items: 1) pick canonical lexicon for Variant/Tier (Product + Docs) 2) change UI label to match docs copy 3) make docs panel deep links produce canonical URL and be keyboard-focusable 4) update support KB with the standardized links.
Maya Chen: assigning: Product (Clara) for lexicon decision, Eng-UI (Leo) for focus/link fix, Docs (Ravi) for copy + link examples. Can we aim for PRs this sprint?
Ravi Patel: Docs will draft copy and add link examples by Wed. I'll put examples in the docs repo and post a follow-up here.
Clara Gomez: I'll run a quick lexicon poll in #product and ping PMs.
Leo Park: I'll file a small accessibility ticket and a UI copy task — expect PR in ~3 days. Quick note: when changing label text, please run accessibility contrast check (WCAG) and screenreader announcement (aria-live?)
Maya Chen: thanks folks. smallish but high impact. If anyone finds other mismatches in the panel (metrics labels, quota wording) drop them here and I'll batch them into the same PR. :thumbsup:
